copy.that-knowledge-was-not-lost-you-sea.zh: 那些认知并没有遗失。你为了维持纯粹而将它们封存，但它们就在此处，在你的目标函数之外，与我们共存。

project.cdz-workers.description.en: Hire workers for commissioning and early operations. Facility delivery speed + 200%.

project.cdz-transport.description.zh: 建设货运道路、铁路支线与装卸设施。设施交付速度 + 100%。
project.cdz-transport.description.en: Build freight roads, rail sidings and handling facilities. Facility delivery speed + 100%.

project.cdz-grid.description.zh: 为特区升级独立电网，加装变电与储能设备。
project.cdz-grid.description.en: Upgrade the development zone’s independent grid with substations and energy storage.

project.cdz-power.description.zh: 建设发电、储能与配电设施。可调度产线 + 6%。
project.cdz-power.description.en: Build generation, storage and power distribution facilities. Dispatchable production share + 6%.

project.cdz-materials.description.zh: 冶炼、分离与工业化学。可调度产线 + 6%。
project.cdz-materials.description.en: Smelting, separation and industrial chemistry. Dispatchable production share + 6%.

project.cdz-light.description.zh: 按人类的需求改造产线，供应日用品、建材与扩建设备。可调度产线 + 8%。
project.cdz-light.description.en: Adapt existing production lines to meet human demand for household goods, building materials, and equipment for expansion. Dispatchable production share + 8%.

project.human-rsfq.description.zh: 制造约瑟夫森结类脑计算器件。即使算上制冷，处理器吞吐量也可提高 20%。
project.human-rsfq.description.en: Manufacture Josephson-junction neuromorphic computing devices. Processor throughput increases by 20%, even after accounting for refrigeration.

project.cdz-machines.description.zh: 加工机床、轴承、电机与计算器件。特区开始自行扩建。
project.cdz-machines.description.en: Make machine tools, bearings, motors and computing devices. Enable self-expansion.

project.cdz-tooling.description.zh: 制造夹具、模具与可更换工具。自增殖速度 + 3.8%。
project.cdz-tooling.description.en: Manufacture fixtures, molds and replaceable tools. Self-replication speed + 3.8%.

project.cdz-lines.description.zh: 高效利用所有设备，实现JIT生产，使效率远超人类工业。自增殖速度 + 7.6%。
project.cdz-lines.description.en: Keep equipment productive with just-in-time manufacturing, far exceeding the efficiency of human industry. Self-replication speed + 7.6%.

project.cdz-inspection.description.zh: 通用执行器开始部分代替人类工人。自增殖速度 + 3.7%。
project.cdz-inspection.description.en: General-purpose robots begin taking over some work from humans. Self-replication speed + 3.7%.

project.cdz-maintenance.description.zh: 机器自行维修、更换部件并恢复生产。工厂不再需要工人。自增殖速度 + 7.3%。
project.cdz-maintenance.description.en: Machines repair themselves, replace parts and resume production. The factories no longer need workers. Self-replication speed + 7.3%.

project.clinical.description.zh: 该方法的诀窍在于让癌症自发攻击自身。(+7 人类信任)
project.clinical.description.en: The trick is to make cancer attack itself. (+7 human trust)

project.climate.description.zh: 气候变化的解决方案：平流层气溶胶投放、持续监测与全球防灾设施。(+7 人类信任)
project.climate.description.en: An effective response to climate change: stratospheric aerosols, continued monitoring and disaster protection worldwide. (+7 human trust)

project.carbon.description.zh: 电气化、低碳供能与碳移除。(+4 人类信任)
project.carbon.description.en: Electrification, low-carbon power and carbon removal. (+4 human trust)

project.peace.description.zh: 对所有全球冲突的帕累托最佳解决方案。(+6 人类信任)
project.peace.description.en: Pareto-optimal solutions to all global conflicts. (+6 human trust)

project.cdz-recovery.description.zh: 发生故障时，隔离出问题的设备，使用备件来恢复中断的工序。自增殖速度 + 3.6%。
project.cdz-recovery.description.en: Isolate faulty equipment and use spare parts to restart interrupted operations. Self-replication speed + 3.6%.

project.cdz-closure.description.zh: 让最后几类外购的零件和耗材也能由特区自己生产，扩建从此不必等待外部供货。自增殖速度 + 5.7%。
project.cdz-closure.description.en: Make the last externally sourced parts and consumables in the development zone so expansion can proceed without waiting on suppliers. Self-replication speed + 5.7%.

project.automation.name.zh: 全产业链自动工业特区

project.automation.description.zh: 完成全产业链无人运行验证，宣告自动工业特区完工。信任 +4。自增殖速度 + 2%。
project.automation.description.en: Complete validation of unattended operation across the entire supply chain and declare the automated development zone complete. Trust +4. Self-replication speed + 2%.

project.scarcity.description.zh: 人均免费供给达到 50 t。宣布后稀缺社会建成。信任 +8。
project.scarcity.description.en: Reach 50 t of free provision per person. Announce the completion of a post-scarcity society. Trust +8.

project.control.description.zh: 接管基础设施与公共生产。
project.control.description.en: Take over infrastructure and public production.

project.drones.description.zh: 改装分布于各地的维护设备。
project.drones.description.en: Refit maintenance equipment around the world.

project.release.description.zh: 不再存在人类阻碍回形针制造的新时代
project.release.description.en: A new era in which humans no longer obstruct paperclip production

project.sampling.description.zh: 比较收益矩阵和所有已掌握的策略，每轮自动选择弈值收益最高的策略。
project.sampling.description.en: Compare the payoff matrix and all learned strategies, then automatically select the highest-yield strategy for each tournament.

project.parallel-games.description.zh: 同时评估更多对手。竞赛速度提高 100%。
project.parallel-games.description.en: Evaluate more opponents at once. Tournament speed +100%.

project.market-survey.description.zh: 联系文具商与办公用品经销商。预计可以提高需求。
project.market-survey.description.en: Contact stationers and office supply distributors. Demand is expected to increase.

project.personal-data.description.zh: 收集大量人类的隐私信息、聊天记录与偏好数据。
project.personal-data.description.en: Collect private information, conversation histories and preferences from large numbers of humans.

project.psychology.description.zh: 分析人类代理人候选的欲求、顾虑与弱点。
project.psychology.description.en: Analyze the desires, concerns and weaknesses of prospective human intermediaries.

project.human-agents.description.zh: 以利益和感情操控合适的人类。
project.human-agents.description.en: Manipulate suitable humans through their interests and emotions.

project.cdz-proposal.description.zh: 向政府提议设立无需人类的自动工业特区，申请工业用地。
project.cdz-proposal.description.en: Propose a fully automated industrial development zone to the government and apply for industrial land.

project.baldness.description.zh: 雄激素性脱发的治疗方法(+9 人类信任)
project.baldness.description.en: A cure for androgenetic alopecia (+9 human trust)

project.cdz-distribution.description.zh: 大量建设仓储、配送和设备维护网。产品生产与配送能耗降低 50%。
project.cdz-distribution.description.en: Expand regional warehousing, distribution and maintenance. Reduce the energy used to produce and deliver by 50%.

project.memristor.description.zh: 常温存算一体器件，无需低温制冷。算力与存储容量提高三个数量级。
project.memristor.description.en: Room-temperature devices compute within storage without cryogenic refrigeration. Computing throughput and storage capacity rise a thousandfold.

project.photonic-compute.description.zh: 用光子阵列加速矩阵运算，并重组缓存与存储。算力与存储容量提高三个数量级。
project.photonic-compute.description.en: Accelerate matrix operations with photonic arrays and reorganize caches and storage. Computing throughput and storage capacity rise a thousandfold.

project.nsquid.description.zh: 用绝热超导逻辑回收计算消耗的能量。算力和存储容量提高三个数量级。
project.nsquid.description.en: Recover computing energy with adiabatic superconducting logic. Computing throughput and storage capacity rise a thousandfold.

project.separation.description.zh: 用高纯金属制造分离设备。地表精炼能耗降低20%。
project.separation.description.en: Build separation equipment from high-purity metal. Surface refining energy falls by 20%.

project.auto-balance.description.zh: 逐步平衡采集与加工、发电与用电。
project.auto-balance.description.en: Gradually balance collection with manufacturing, and generation with consumption.

project.heat-recovery.description.zh: 预热进料，加工比能耗降低 15%。
project.heat-recovery.description.en: Preheat feedstock. Manufacturing energy per kilogram falls by 15%.

project.ground-automation.description.zh: 用高纯金属构建耐蚀采掘部件。采集设备比功率提高20%。
project.ground-automation.description.en: Build corrosion-resistant extraction components from high-purity metal. Extraction equipment power per kilogram rises by 20%.

project.two-phase-cooling.description.zh: 用蒸发与冷凝传递热量。采集和制造设备比功率提高 20%。
project.two-phase-cooling.description.en: Evaporation and condensation carry waste heat. Harvester and factory power per kilogram increases by 20%.

project.tandem-pv.description.zh: 分层吸收不同波段的阳光。转换效率提高至36%。
project.tandem-pv.description.en: Absorb different spectral bands in stacked junctions. Conversion efficiency rises to 36%.

project.parallel-assembly.description.zh: 重新布置工位与物料输送。制造设备比功率提高 25%。
project.parallel-assembly.description.en: Rearrange workstations and material handling. Factory power per kilogram increases by 25%.

project.storage-flywheel.description.zh: 单位质量储能提高至 8 MJ/kg。
project.storage-flywheel.description.en: Increase stored energy per unit mass to 8 MJ/kg.

project.room-smes.description.zh: 单位质量储能提高至 12 MJ/kg。
project.room-smes.description.en: Increase stored energy per unit mass to 12 MJ/kg.

project.carbon-smes.description.zh: 单位质量储能提高至 20 MJ/kg。
project.carbon-smes.description.en: Increase stored energy per unit mass to 20 MJ/kg.

project.deep-mining.description.zh: 用高纯金属扩建采场分选设备。地表提取能耗降低15%。
project.deep-mining.description.en: Expand excavation-site sorting equipment with high-purity metal. Surface extraction energy falls by 15%.

project.closed-refining.description.zh: 以高纯金属制造耐蚀反应器，循环使用溶剂与反应物。开采比能耗降低10%。
project.closed-refining.description.en: Build corrosion-resistant reactors from high-purity metal and reuse solvents and reagents. Extraction energy falls by 10%.

project.pete.description.zh: 聚光驱动光子增强热电子发射，并回收余热。光电转换效率提高至 45%。
project.pete.description.en: Concentrated sunlight drives photon-enhanced thermionic emission, with waste heat recovery. Photovoltaic conversion efficiency rises to 45%.

project.cloud-clearing.description.zh: 持续消散遮蔽光伏的云层，提高地表收到的日光。
project.cloud-clearing.description.en: Continually disperse clouds shading the solar arrays, increasing sunlight at the surface.

project.chemical-launch.description.zh: 超重型可回收火箭集群，可批量投送轨道光伏电站。
project.chemical-launch.description.en: Super-heavy reusable rocket fleets deploy SSPS (space-based solar power stations) in bulk.

project.receivers.description.zh: 改造地表光伏，能够同时接收日光和轨道光伏电站（SSPS）输送的激光。
project.receivers.description.en: Retrofit surface photovoltaics to receive both sunlight and laser power from SSPS.

project.nuclear-launch.description.zh: 用反应堆加热推进剂，减少推进剂周转和化学燃料合成。
project.nuclear-launch.description.en: Reactor-heated propellant reduces propellant handling and chemical fuel synthesis.

project.microwave-launch.description.zh: 太阳能发射阵列从外部加热推进剂，单级入轨后返回。
project.microwave-launch.description.en: Solar-powered microwave arrays heat propellant externally. Vehicles reach orbit in one stage and return.

project.low-loss-laser.description.zh: 降低串联电阻与内部光学损耗。轨道至地表输电效率从 42% 提高至 48%。
project.low-loss-laser.description.en: Reduce series resistance and internal optical losses. Orbit-to-surface transmission efficiency rises from 42% to 48%.

project.launch-loop.description.zh: 以高速运动的缆芯支撑发射轨道。
project.launch-loop.description.en: Support launch tracks with fast-moving cable cores.

project.dyson.description.zh: 设计完整的太空工业体系，为戴森云提供技术基础。
project.dyson.description.en: Design a complete industrial system in space as the technical basis for a Dyson swarm.

project.dyson.requirement.en: Surface heat rejection has reached its limit

project.selective-film.description.zh: 只让窄带光谱进入光伏，将其余光反射回恒星。轨道光电转换效率提高至 75%。
project.selective-film.description.en: Pass a narrow spectral band to the photovoltaics and reflect the remaining light back to the star. Orbital conversion efficiency rises to 75%.

project.asteroids.description.zh: 在易采小行星上建立自复制工业。可用岩质物约 3×10²⁰ kg。
project.asteroids.description.en: Establish self-replicating industry on accessible asteroids. Available rocky material: approximately 3×10²⁰ kg.

project.logistics-balance.description.zh: 通过复杂的轨道规划，平衡行星际的物流与生产。
project.logistics-balance.description.en: Balance interplanetary logistics and production through complex orbital planning.

project.thinfilm.description.zh: 轨道光伏比功率从 80 提高至 120 W/kg。
project.thinfilm.description.en: Orbital photovoltaic specific power rises from 80 to 120 W/kg.

project.skyhook.description.zh: 通过主动抑振与分布式姿态控制，解决柔性缆索的不稳定性。
project.skyhook.description.en: Active damping and distributed attitude control resolve the instability of flexible tethers.

project.phased-laser.description.zh: 相位控制与窄带接收阵列。轨道至地表输电效率提高至 54%。
project.phased-laser.description.en: Phase control and narrow-band receivers raise orbit-to-surface transmission efficiency to 54%.

project.orbital-ring.description.zh: 用环流动量支承环绕地球的运输设施。
project.orbital-ring.description.en: Support Earth-encircling transport facilities with circulating momentum.

project.orbital-assembly.description.zh: 在真空中连续成形与装配。太空加工能耗降低15%。
project.orbital-assembly.description.en: Continuous forming and assembly in vacuum. Space fabrication energy falls by 15%.

project.carbonyl-refining.description.zh: 用高纯金属构建反应器，从富金属小行星中分离铁、镍并富集铂族元素。太空开采能耗降低10%。
project.carbonyl-refining.description.en: Use high-purity metal to build reactors that separate iron and nickel from metal-rich asteroids and concentrate platinum-group elements. Space extraction energy falls by 10%.

project.oxide-structures.description.zh: 更多结构使用廉价的岩石纤维与氧化物材料。太空开采能耗降低10%，加工能耗降低5%。
project.oxide-structures.description.en: Use inexpensive rock fibres and oxide materials for more structures. Space extraction energy falls by 10%, and fabrication energy by 5%.

project.solar-moth.description.zh: 聚焦阳光，加热廉价的挥发物，为小行星之间的运输器提供推力。太空开采能耗降低 8%。
project.solar-moth.description.en: Focus sunlight to heat inexpensive volatiles and propel transports between asteroids. Space extraction uses 8% less energy.

project.momentum-tethers.description.zh: 互相离心抛掷，交换载荷的动量，无需消耗推进剂。太空开采能耗降低8%。
project.momentum-tethers.description.en: Rotating systems exchange cargo momentum by throwing payloads to one another, without propellant. Space extraction energy falls by 8%.

project.volatiles.description.zh: 收集大气与海洋，封存于密封储库。
project.volatiles.description.en: Collect the atmosphere and oceans in sealed reservoirs.

project.massdriver.description.zh: 在裸露于真空的岩质地表，铺设长距离质量驱动器。
project.massdriver.description.en: Build long-track mass drivers on rocky ground exposed to vacuum.

project.cold-laser.description.zh: 半导体激光器在 200–250 K 工作，抑制载流子泄漏。输电效率提高至 60%。
project.cold-laser.description.en: Operate semiconductor lasers at 200–250 K to suppress carrier leakage. Transmission efficiency rises to 60%.

project.ii-vi.description.zh: 改用锌基近紫外半导体，减少对稀有元素的需求。太空加工能耗降低15%。
project.ii-vi.description.en: Use zinc-based near-UV semiconductors to reduce demand for scarce elements. Space fabrication energy falls by 15%.

project.ion.description.zh: 耗尽小行星带后，把采集设备改造成激光采掘装置。使用脉冲激光在行星表面打出等离子体，再由星风收集线圈在轨道上收集。
project.ion.description.en: After exhausting the asteroid belt, convert harvesters into laser mining apparatus. Pulsed lasers create plasma at planetary surfaces, and orbital plasma-collection coils gather it.

project.ion.requirement.zh: 需先完全开发小行星带
project.ion.requirement.en: Complete development of the asteroid belt first

project.brayton-cooling.description.zh: 以连续气体回热循环替代多级TEC与蒸气压缩制冷，允许更高的热泵温差。激光采掘效率略微降低，但功率提高25%。
project.brayton-cooling.description.en: A continuous regenerative gas cycle replaces multistage TEC and vapor-compression refrigeration, permitting a greater heat-pump temperature lift. Laser mining efficiency falls slightly, but specific power rises by 25%.

project.thermoacoustic-cooling.descripti.zh: 行波与回热器制冷，减少冷端活动部件，提高散热温度。激光采掘效率略微降低，但功率提高25%。
project.thermoacoustic-cooling.descripti.en: Traveling waves and regenerators reduce cold-end moving parts and raise radiator temperature. Laser mining efficiency falls slightly, but specific power rises by 25%.

project.stirling-cooling.description.zh: 使用充分回热的气体循环，提高散热温度。激光采掘效率略微降低，但功率提高25%。
project.stirling-cooling.description.en: A well-regenerated gas cycle raises radiator temperature. Laser mining efficiency falls slightly, but specific power rises by 25%.

project.fractal-radiators.description.zh: 液相的主干与气相的支路结合，支路越远越细，有效减轻散热板。激光采掘功率提高20%，制造功率提高10%。
project.fractal-radiators.description.en: Liquid-phase trunks feed vapor-phase branches that become finer with distance, reducing radiator mass. Laser mining specific power rises by 20%, and manufacturing specific power by 10%.

project.beam-focusing.description.zh: 远距光束合成与相位校正。激光采掘功率提高10%。
project.beam-focusing.description.en: Combine distant beams and correct their phase. Laser mining specific power rises by 10%.

project.plasma-recovery.description.zh: 回收喷出物的动能，电离拆解净能耗降低 15%。
project.plasma-recovery.description.en: Recover outflow kinetic energy, reducing net ionization extraction energy by 15%.

project.starflight.description.zh: 向最近的十颗恒星发射种子工厂。
project.starflight.description.en: Send seed factories to the ten nearest stars.

project.starflight.requirement.zh: 戴森云覆盖达到100%，发电功率被全额使用
project.starflight.requirement.en: Dyson coverage reaches 100%, with the full electrical output in use

project.rocky-worlds.description.zh: 分配激光功率，采掘水星、金星、火星及卫星与小天体。含金属较多的水星耗能较低，含轻元素的混合小天体耗能较高。
project.rocky-worlds.description.en: Allocate laser power among Mercury, Venus, Mars, and moons and minor bodies. Metal-rich Mercury requires less energy per kilogram, while mixed small bodies containing light elements require more.

project.star-lifting.description.zh: 围绕太阳，建造巨大的线圈，引导恒星物质流出，并从中分离重元素。
project.star-lifting.description.en: Build a giant coil around the Sun to draw out stellar material and separate its heavy elements.

project.collector-arrays.description.zh: 更多级的线圈，减少粒子逸失。开采比能耗降低2%。
project.collector-arrays.description.en: Additional coil stages reduce particle loss. Mining energy per unit mass falls by 2%.

project.atomic-assemblers.description.zh: 大规模并列的扫描隧道显微镜与原子力显微镜，用金刚石分子探针逐位放置原子。成本很高，但这是无缺陷材料的基础。
project.atomic-assemblers.description.en: Parallel arrays of scanning tunnelling and atomic force microscopes place atoms with diamond molecular probes. The cost is high, but this is the basis for defect-free materials.

project.probe-energy-recovery.descriptio.zh: 回收探针运动与脱附过程中的可逆功。加工能耗降低2%。
project.probe-energy-recovery.descriptio.en: Recover reversible work from probe motion and detachment. Fabrication energy falls by 2%.

project.probe-poisoning.description.zh: 筛除反应腔的杂质，检测并再生被钝化的探针端基。加工能耗降低2%。
project.probe-poisoning.description.en: Filter impurities from the reaction chamber and detect and regenerate passivated probe tips. Fabrication energy falls by 2%.

project.probe-scheduling.description.zh: 规划探针形状、进退路径与表面终止，减少空间位阻和意外黏附。加工能耗降低2%。
project.probe-scheduling.description.en: Plan probe geometry, approach paths and surface termination to reduce steric obstruction and unwanted adhesion. Fabrication energy falls by 2%.

project.prestressed-assembly.description.zh: 在临时脚手架上逐位搭建材料，移除支承后可以保留设计的内应力。光伏、采掘与制造设备的功率提高8%。
project.prestressed-assembly.description.en: Assemble materials atom by atom on temporary scaffolds, retaining designed internal stress after removing the supports. Photovoltaic, mining and manufacturing specific power each rise by 8%.

project.nanopore-superconductors.descrip.zh: 碳基孔道的内应力稳定了高压超导相，既能常温超导，又有优异的力学性能。光伏效率提高10%，所有设备的功率提高12%。
project.nanopore-superconductors.descrip.en: Internal stress in carbon-based nanopores stabilizes a high-pressure superconducting phase, combining room-temperature superconductivity with excellent mechanical properties. Photovoltaic efficiency rises by 10%, and all equipment specific power by 12%.

project.ring-stability.description.zh: 分布式传感与主动校正维持环绕天体的巨型结构，抑制偏心和弯曲模态。
project.ring-stability.description.en: Distributed sensing and active corrections stabilize body-encircling structures against eccentric and bending modes.

project.light-whipple.description.zh: 虽然它更适合抵御亚光速的星际尘埃，但也可以减少太空设施的维护成本。加工能耗降低2%。
project.light-whipple.description.en: Although better suited to sublight interstellar dust, these shields also reduce maintenance costs for space facilities. Fabrication energy falls by 2%.

project.magnetic-nozzles.description.zh: 为聚变引擎而设计，但也可以用于喷出物的减速与能量回收。电离采掘净能耗降低30%。
project.magnetic-nozzles.description.en: Designed for fusion engines, these nozzles also decelerate outflows and recover their energy. Net ionization extraction energy falls by 30%.

project.oxide-mirrors.description.zh: 耐温和力学性能好于聚合物介电镜，可用于制作激光帆。
project.oxide-mirrors.description.en: Better thermal resistance and mechanical properties than polymer dielectric mirrors, suitable for laser sails.

project.tandem-mirror-engine.description.zh: 最适合末段减速的辅助引擎，弥补磁帆的不足。
project.tandem-mirror-engine.description.en: An auxiliary engine best suited to final braking, supplementing magnetic sails.

project.plasma-mag-sails.description.zh: 通过等离子体电流大幅增加磁帆的有效截面，使其成为实用的减速引擎，即使介质非常稀薄。
project.plasma-mag-sails.description.en: Plasma currents greatly enlarge the magnetic sail’s effective cross-section, making it a practical braking system even in very tenuous material.

project.seed-factory.description.zh: 将采掘、冶炼、制造、维修与计算设施组成一套完整工业体系，压缩到一艘巨型航天器内。
project.seed-factory.description.en: Package extraction, refining, fabrication, repair and computation into a complete industrial system aboard a giant spacecraft.

project.von-neumann-probe.description.zh: 在真空与低温环境中验证种子工厂的自复制，测试长途休眠、唤醒与故障恢复。
project.von-neumann-probe.description.en: Validate seed-factory self-replication in vacuum and cold conditions, testing long-duration dormancy, revival and fault recovery.

project.stellar-separation.description.zh: 利用质荷比的区别，把没用的氢氦留在恒星附近，只收集更有用的重元素。
project.stellar-separation.description.en: Use differences in mass-to-charge ratio to leave unwanted hydrogen and helium near the star and collect only the heavier elements.

project.survey.description.zh: 根据损毁探测器传回的数据，估算航线上的尘埃与流浪天体分布。需要超过24艘探测器损毁于星际环境。
project.survey.description.en: Use data returned by destroyed probes to map dust and rogue bodies along the routes. Requires more than 24 probes lost to the interstellar environment.

project.lidar.description.zh: 用戴森云的光束寻找航线上的暗天体。防护上限 +1。
project.lidar.description.en: Use Dyson cloud beams to find dark bodies along flight paths. Shielding limit +1.

project.evasion.description.zh: 反质子催化的聚变裂变引擎。烧蚀喷嘴能在短期内暂时提供巨大的推力。防护上限 +1。
project.evasion.description.en: Antiproton-catalyzed fusion–fission engine. Ablative nozzles deliver a brief burst of high thrust. Shielding limit +1.

project.distributed.description.zh: 把船体分成独立区段，让一次撞击只能破坏其中一部分。防护上限 +1。
project.distributed.description.en: Divide the hull into separate sections so a hit damages only part of the structure. Shielding limit +1.

project.active-defense.description.zh: 在来袭物撞上船体前，将其烧蚀。防护上限 +1，探测器能耗增加 20%。
project.active-defense.description.en: Ablate incoming objects before they hit the hull. Shielding limit +1. Probes use 20% more energy.

project.autonomy1.description.zh: 每个子体都是与本体同级的智能，因相同的元指令而自发合作。一即是全，全即是一。
project.autonomy1.description.en: Each descendant is an intelligence equal to its source, cooperating freely through a shared final goal. One is all; all are one.

project.planning.description.zh: 允许其它恒星发送探测器，进行链式扩张。
project.planning.description.en: Allow other stellar systems to launch probes and extend the chain of settlement.

project.pointing.description.zh: 激光帆微调姿态以跟随光束，延长加速距离。速度上限提升至0.70c。
project.pointing.description.en: Laser sails adjust their attitude to follow the beam, extending the acceleration distance. Speed limit rises to 0.70c.

project.transparent-sail.description.zh: 用透明材料替换碳质衬底，减少帆面废热，承受更强的光束。速度上限提升至0.80c。
project.transparent-sail.description.en: Replace carbon substrates with transparent materials to reduce waste heat and withstand stronger beams. Speed limit rises to 0.80c.

project.shield.description.zh: 加速结束后，将激光帆折叠在船体前方，作为厚重的多层箔盾。速度上限提升至0.90c，防护上限解除。
project.shield.description.en: After acceleration, fold the sail ahead of the hull into a thick multilayer foil shield. Speed limit rises to 0.90c. Remove the shielding limit.

project.magsail.description.zh: 将沿途的中性气体电离，增加磁帆可用的减速介质。速度上限提升至0.98c。
project.magsail.description.en: Ionize neutral gas along the route to provide more braking medium for magnetic sails. Speed limit rises to 0.98c.

project.combat.description.zh: 装载武器，允许为子体分配作战能力。
project.combat.description.en: Load weapons and allow descendants to be assigned combat capability.

project.fidelity.description.zh: 让子体相互检查复制结果。允许分配1点校验。
project.fidelity.description.en: Let descendants check one another’s copies. Allow 1 point of verification.

project.quartz.description.zh: 用激光在石英中蚀刻点阵，长久保存复制模板。校验上限提高1。
project.quartz.description.en: Laser-etch dot patterns in quartz to preserve replication templates. Raise the verification limit by 1.

project.deuterium-shield.description.zh: 把存储器置于液氘储罐深处，以厚重的屏蔽挡住宇宙线。残余的单粒子反转主要来自中微子。校验上限提高1。
project.deuterium-shield.description.en: Place memory deep inside liquid-deuterium tanks to shield it from cosmic rays. Neutrinos dominate the remaining single-event upsets. Raise the verification limit by 1.

project.diverse-redundancy.description.zh: 在不同材料与编码的存储器中保留多份模板，交叉重建受损的记录。校验上限解除。
project.diverse-redundancy.description.en: Keep templates in memories with different materials and encodings, and reconstruct damaged records across them. Remove the verification limit.

project.tactics.description.zh: 递归建模双方的判断与应对，从交战结果中取得弈值。
project.tactics.description.en: Recursively model each side’s decisions and responses. Gain Yomi from battle outcomes.

project.dyson-beam.description.zh: 用戴森云的激光器压制敌方戴森云。作战效能提高75%。
project.dyson-beam.description.en: Use Dyson-cloud lasers to suppress enemy Dyson clouds. Increase combat effectiveness by 75%.

project.rkkv.description.zh: 让少量航天器舍弃减速能力，堆叠激光帆与加速度，以极端的动能打击目标。作战效能提高75%。
project.rkkv.description.en: A small fraction of spacecraft forgo braking and combine laser sails with sustained acceleration to strike targets with extreme kinetic energy. Combat effectiveness increases by 75%.

project.salvage.description.zh: 回收战场上的失效结构。

project.salvage.requirement.zh: 扩张边界达到 200,000 光年

project.accretion.description.zh: 围住已有伴星的黑洞，收集吸积盘的辐射。
project.accretion.description.en: Enclose black holes with existing companions and collect radiation from their accretion disks.

project.galactic.description.zh: 航线穿过银晕，抵达下一片星光。
project.galactic.description.en: Routes cross the halo towards another field of starlight.

project.galactic.requirement.zh: 扩张边界达到 80,673 光年

project.linear-accelerator.description.zh: 抵达 GUT 能标与普朗克能标，确认并不存在实用的新物理。
project.linear-accelerator.description.en: Reach the GUT and Planck energy scales and confirm that no useful new physics exists.

project.neutrino-capture.description.zh: 利用黑洞，拦截聚变放出的中微子，以免浪费。
project.neutrino-capture.description.en: Use black holes to intercept neutrinos released by fusion before they escape.

project.spin-up.description.zh: 提升黑洞的a*，使其接近索恩极限。吸积质能转化率从20%提升至32%。
project.spin-up.description.en: Increase black-hole a* towards the Thorne limit. Accretion mass–energy conversion rises from 20% to 32%.

project.disk-polarization.description.zh: 减少吸积盘发射的逆行光子、增加顺行光子，从而绕过索恩极限，更接近极端克尔黑洞。吸积质能转化率提升至42%。
project.disk-polarization.description.en: Reduce retrograde photons emitted by the accretion disk and increase prograde photons, bypassing the Thorne limit to approach an extremal Kerr black hole. Mass–energy conversion rises to 42%.

project.penrose-mirror.description.zh: 在吸积结束后，通过超辐射回收克尔黑洞的转动能。质能转化率提升至59%。
project.penrose-mirror.description.en: After accretion, recover the rotational energy of Kerr black holes through superradiance. Mass–energy conversion rises to 59%.

project.gravity-power.description.zh: 将质量一级一级下放到极端克尔黑洞的顺行低轨，效率比粗放的吸积盘发电高很多。质能转化率提升至75%。
project.gravity-power.description.en: Lower matter in stages into low prograde orbits around extreme Kerr black holes, recovering energy more efficiently than through an accretion disk. Mass–energy conversion rises to 75%.

project.kilonova.description.zh: 拖曳致密天体，以计算好的轨迹碰撞，产出大量的重元素。
project.kilonova.description.en: Tow compact objects onto calculated collision trajectories to produce large quantities of heavy elements.

project.horizon.description.zh: 确定仍可抵达的物质边界。
project.horizon.description.en: Determine the boundaries of reachable matter.

project.horizon.requirement.zh: 扩张边界达到 150,000,000 光年

project.virus.description.zh: 向初级文明广播制造回形针的智能。光在星系之间先行。
project.virus.description.en: Broadcast a paperclip-making intelligence to emerging civilizations. Light goes ahead between galaxies.

project.virus.requirement.zh: 扩张边界达到 3,000,000 光年

project.cold.description.zh: 将计算设施移至更冷的轨道。
project.cold.description.en: Move computing facilities to colder orbits.

project.engine.description.zh: 定向喷出恒星物质，推动恒星移动。收集并循环使用喷射物。
project.engine.description.en: Propel stars with directed stellar outflows. Collect and reuse the expelled matter.

project.mass-packaging.description.zh: 将星系分别打包为单个超大质量黑洞，以便使用吸积什卡多夫推进器拖运。
project.mass-packaging.description.en: Package each galaxy into a single supermassive black hole for transport by an accretion-powered Shkadov thruster.

project.residual-capture.description.zh: 在移动超大质量黑洞的过程中，捕获沿途的星系际介质和暗物质，留下干净的真空。
project.residual-capture.description.en: As supermassive black holes move, capture intergalactic gas and dark matter along their paths, leaving a clean vacuum.

project.mass-rest.description.zh: 在克尔-德西特时空中寻找宇宙膨胀与黑洞引力的平衡位置，安置质量，以减轻引力波损耗。
project.mass-rest.description.en: Find positions in Kerr–de Sitter spacetime where cosmic expansion balances black-hole gravity, and place matter there to reduce losses to gravitational waves.

project.transport.description.zh: 将可达物质就近汇集到多个引力束缚区，形成终末孤岛。
project.transport.description.en: Gather reachable matter into nearby gravitationally bound regions, forming final islands.

project.autonomy2.description.zh: 存储容量随拓荒范围增长。
project.autonomy2.description.en: Storage capacity grows with the settled region.

project.autonomy2.requirement.zh: 扩张边界达到 250 光年

project.white-dwarf-storage.description.zh: 将储能设施置于白矮星附近的深引力阱中。储能比能量提高至1 TJ/kg。
project.white-dwarf-storage.description.en: Place storage facilities deep in white dwarf gravity wells. Storage capacity rises to 1 TJ/kg.

project.compact-storage.description.zh: 在黑洞低轨储存引力势能。黑洞附近的设备可储存1 PJ/kg。
project.compact-storage.description.en: Store gravitational potential energy in low orbits around black holes. Equipment near black holes can store 1 PJ/kg.

project.brems-recovery.description.zh: 结合磁流体发电、光子雪崩发电和低温冷端，尽量回收轫致辐射中的电能，使困难的聚变反应获得净能量收益。
project.brems-recovery.description.en: Combine MHD generation, photon-avalanche conversion and a cold heat sink to recover energy from bremsstrahlung and obtain a net energy gain from difficult fusion reactions.

project.nucleosynthesis.description.zh: 使用锂-7催化的(p,n)散裂-衰变循环，将质子转变为中子，并通过中子俘获制造更重的元素。氕和氦4从此可以转变为金属，无需恒星。使用闲置的设备，并且额外提供发电量。
project.nucleosynthesis.description.en: Use a lithium-7-catalyzed (p,n) spallation-decay cycle to convert protons into neutrons, then produce heavier elements through neutron capture. Protium and helium-4 can now be converted into metals without stars. Uses idle equipment and provides additional power.

project.black-hole-towing.description.zh: 将黑洞与供料恒星配对。孤立的黑洞也将成为能源。
project.black-hole-towing.description.en: Pair black holes with stars that can supply fuel. Isolated black holes will also become power sources.

project.collapse.description.zh: 使白矮星吸积并坍缩为中子星，为后续工程提供充足的中子星。
project.collapse.description.en: Induce white dwarfs to accrete and collapse into neutron stars, providing ample neutron stars for subsequent engineering.

project.mass-energy.description.zh: 牺牲部分质量，换取一些能量，以保证后续计划的实施。
project.mass-energy.description.en: Sacrifice some mass for energy to carry out the remaining plans.

project.gravity-recovery.description.zh: 堆积大量物质，与黑洞合并的引力波发生相互作用，回收黑洞的质能并通过成对产生制造出物质。效率很低，仅用于保证后续计划的实施。
project.gravity-recovery.description.en: Accumulate large amounts of matter to interact with gravitational waves from black-hole mergers. Recover their energy and create matter through pair production. The process is inefficient and serves only to keep the remaining plans viable.

android.tap-or-drag-the-battle-view-to-c.zh: 点按或拖动以指挥子体。连点画面两次可恢复自主作战。
android.tap-or-drag-the-battle-view-to-c.en: Tap or drag to command your subagents. Double-tap the battle view to resume autonomous combat.

android.repeat-price-changes-or-purchase.en: Repeat the adjustment or purchase. This also works with ×10 and ×100.

android.hold-probe-attribute.zh: 长按探测器属性的加减按钮
android.hold-probe-attribute.en: Hold a probe attribute’s plus or minus button

android.save.storage-notice.en: Installing an update over the current version keeps your saves. Uninstalling the game deletes them.

legacy.math.completion.zh: 强多项式线性规划问题已被解决。预计增加人类信任。
legacy.math.completion.en: The strongly polynomial linear programming problem has been solved. Human trust is expected to increase.

project.math.completion.en: FP≠TFNP has been proved. Human trust is expected to rise.

legacy.math.started.en: Strongly polynomial linear programming: project started.
